description:
Is the Audi Nuvolari the ultimate hybrid supercar?!

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-09-11

Mat’s got his hands on the Audi Nuvolari! 

He’s flown over to Spain, and he’s going to have a chance to walk around a pre-production model, take it out on the road, and push it to its limits on track! 

The question is, with it being such a departure from Audi’s recent design language, is it really worth the eye-waveringly large price tag? It’s time to find out, starting with the design… 

One thing’s for sure: there’s no denying the Audi Nuvolari stands out compared to any Audi released in the past several years! The entire bodywork is made of carbon fibre, and it really stands out on the road. Up top you’ll find two huge vents flanking the rectangular grille, all of which are made out of aluminium - there’s no plastic to be found here! title: I drove the Most POWERFUL Audi EVER! Nuvolari Review
